CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present; A is absent.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate sets), an organization/presentation form (coordinates/placement), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present and bound to the same p0/current/n0 referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the identified content's presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: The text explicitly names represented contents (red, blue) with coordinate sets at explicit current times.

D.rationale: Separate origin/status metadata fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, inherited_current, etc.) are attached to identified content entries, distinguishing content identity from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented (coordinate lists, grid orientation) and includes current vs candidate organization entries.
